title: The Summit of Cape Reckoning
author: C. M. Quintana
blurb: Jude Thackeray, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
